props.text: A Couple Massage is a shared spa experience where two guests receive treatments side by side, each with their own therapist. While it's popular with couples, it's also suitable for friends and family members who want to relax together. Each guest can choose their preferred pressure, creating a personalised treatment within the same relaxing environment.

items.question: Is Couple Massage only for romantic couples?
items.answer: No. Couple Massage at Spa Bali Moon simply means two people enjoying treatments together, side by side, each with their own therapist. Friends, siblings, parents with adult children and other family members regularly book this experience as well. Prices start at IDR 319.000 for two for 1 hour of couple Balinese massage.

items.question: Do we receive our massages in the same room?
items.answer: Yes. With a couples massage at Spa Bali Moon, both guests receive their treatments side by side with two therapists in the same private treatment room at our Seminyak spa, or during the same home service appointment at your villa or hotel. Home service costs an extra IDR 150.000 for two therapists.

items.question: Can each person request different pressure?
items.answer: Absolutely. In a couples massage at Spa Bali Moon, each guest has their own consultation before the treatment begins, allowing pressure levels and focus areas to be adjusted individually. One of you can have gentle pressure while the other has firmer pressure, side by side in the same private room or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can we choose different massage treatments?
items.answer: It depends on the package you choose: different massage options may be available for each guest. Spa Bali Moon's couple massages come in Balinese, traditional, deep tissue and warm candle styles. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 and our team will be happy to recommend the most suitable combination when booking.

items.question: Is Couple Massage suitable for honeymooners?
items.answer: Yes. Couple Massage is one of Spa Bali Moon's most popular experiences for honeymoon trips, anniversaries, birthdays and other special occasions, offering a relaxing way to spend quality time together. You can enjoy it side by side in a private room at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel, from IDR 319.000 for two.

items.question: What massage treatments are suitable for a couple massage?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon's couple massages are Balinese, traditional, deep tissue and warm candle massage, each for two guests side by side. The best choice depends on the pressure you both prefer and how you want to feel afterwards: Balinese is gentle to medium, traditional and deep tissue are firmer, and warm candle uses warm oil and smooth strokes.

items.question: How much does a couples massage cost in Bali at Spa Bali Moon?
items.answer: A couple Balinese massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 319.000 for two for 1 hour, IDR 479.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 659.000 for 2 hours. Couple packages start at IDR 639.000 for two. All prices are for both guests together; home service adds IDR 150.000 for two therapists.

items.question: Can we have a couples massage at our villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. For a couples massage at your villa or hotel, Spa Bali Moon sends two therapists to your accommodation so you can relax side by side. A home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist applies, so IDR 150.000 for two, on top of the treatment price from IDR 319.000 for two. Book on WhatsApp.

items.question: What is included in a couples spa package?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon has four couple packages, each priced for two guests. Package A is a 1-hour Balinese massage plus a 30-minute ear candle (IDR 639.000 for two). Package B is a 1-hour Balinese massage plus a 1-hour Bali Moon facial (IDR 709.000). Packages C and D use the warm candle massage instead (IDR 849.000 and IDR 929.000).

items.question: Can we book a couples massage over Christmas and New Year?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon is open daily from 9am to 11pm, and holiday weeks are busy in Seminyak, so message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 a few days ahead. You can relax side by side in a private room at our spa or at your villa (IDR 150.000 for two therapists), from IDR 319.000 for two.
